lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is actually two back-to-back hearings on the same project: Tuesday, September 30 brings a special HARC session reviewing preliminary architecture for the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W. Pacific Ave, followed immediately by a special Town Council session to hear a legal appeal of the lot consolidation that has to happen before any of that construction can move forward. Also worth knowing: county commissioners take up a proposed Employee Housing Impact Fee on the 30th, and the Town sits down Thursday to sketch out the 2027 General Fund budget.

notable.stake: HARC reviews three building clusters in the contested Carhenge redevelopment.
Council hears appeal that could block or greenlight the Carhenge lot consolidation.
Commissioners discuss a new Employee Housing Impact Fee for San Miguel County.
Final architecture review for 15 employee apartments could advance workforce housing.
2027 General Fund and Capital budget contours take shape before formal adoption.
